cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0)

find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE})
project(sensor_node)

target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.c src/sensor_sim.c)

# The demo CA certificate (public part only) is generated by `make certs` and
# embedded as DER. The firmware trusts exactly this CA for the MQTT broker.
set(DEMO_CA_DER ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../certs/generated/demo-ca.der)
if(NOT EXISTS ${DEMO_CA_DER})
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing ${DEMO_CA_DER}: run `make certs` first")
endif()
set(gen_dir ${ZEPHYR_BINARY_DIR}/include/generated)
generate_inc_file_for_target(app ${DEMO_CA_DER} ${gen_dir}/demo_ca.der.inc)

# Reproducibility: strip absolute build and workspace paths from debug info and
# __FILE__ so the image does not depend on where the workspace lives.
get_filename_component(WEST_TOPDIR ${ZEPHYR_BASE}/.. ABSOLUTE)
# Order matters: GCC applies the LAST matching map. The build directory usually lives
# inside the west workspace (/ws/build/...), so the more specific build-dir map must
# come after the workspace map, otherwise the build path leaks as "ws/build/...".
zephyr_compile_options(
  -ffile-prefix-map=${WEST_TOPDIR}=ws
  -ffile-prefix-map=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}=build
)
# native_sim: the native simulator runner is compiled separately from Zephyr;
# give it the same prefix maps so zephyr.exe is path-independent as well.
if(TARGET native_simulator)
  target_compile_options(native_simulator INTERFACE
    -ffile-prefix-map=${WEST_TOPDIR}=ws
    -ffile-prefix-map=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}=build
  )
endif()
